name: UnQ-BE
description: Backend for UnQ -> A Food & Drinks ordering web application. Solo capstone project developed for Strive School's Full Stack program!

paragraphs: The API behind UnQ, a QR-code ordering app for venues. Diners scan the code on their table, order into one shared cart, and each pay for exactly what they picked, by card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or PayPal. This repository holds the data model, authentication, the manager's tools and the money. The React client is UnQ-FE.
Express 5 · TypeScript 6 · MongoDB with Mongoose 9 · Stripe and PayPal · Jest integration suite

UnQ began as a five-week solo capstone in 2021 and was rebuilt in 2026: Express 5, TypeScript 6 and Mongoose 9, validation on every write, refresh-token rotation, card payments beside PayPal, the manager's tools, the integration suite, the OpenAPI contract. Released under the MIT licence.
